classification_rules.explicit_refusal: finish_reason=content_filter AND (nonempty message.refusal OR native_finish_reason=refusal). Only these accepted empty responses become zero slots.
classification_rules.capped_output: Nonempty final content AND finish_reason=length; retained as capped text.
classification_rules.length_limited_no_final_content: Empty final content AND finish_reason=length. Not a refusal; retried with larger token budget. Reasoning-token usage is supporting evidence, not proof of the sole cause.
classification_rules.missing_or_unaccepted_final_content: Anything else; not accepted as a refusal or zero slot.

sanitization: Allowlist only. No prompts, final text, reasoning text, refusal text, credentials, request IDs or headers. These are author-exported provider fields, not cryptographically authenticated provider attestations.
